content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (bundling), meaning the service is considered part of another paid service, not a medical-necessity or authorization issue. Auth is not required here, so retro-auth/P2P for auth don't apply, and prior appeal and correct_and_resubmit already failed on the same CO-97. A CO-97 bundling denial is a coding/edit dispute; the right move is a formal appeal demonstrating separate payability with supporting records rather than repeated resubmissions. With good documentation (0.88), submitting supporting medical records to substantiate the service as separately payable is the appropriate next progression.","action":"submit_with_records"}
